entry.name: Image
entry.label: Picture to render (file URL)

entry.name: RecentImages
entry.label: Recently chosen pictures (newest first)

entry.name: SlideMode
entry.label: 0 = single picture, 1 = slideshow folder

entry.name: SlideFolder
entry.label: Slideshow folder (URL)

entry.name: SlideInterval
entry.label: Slideshow interval in minutes

entry.name: SlideShuffle
entry.label: Slideshow in random order

entry.name: FillMode
entry.label: 0 = Fill (cover), 1 = Fit (contain, black bars), 2 = Center (native size)

entry.name: FocusY
entry.label: Fill only: which part of a taller picture stays on screen (0 top, 0.5 centre, 1 bottom)

entry.name: Look
entry.label: 0 = Glyph field (dim 24 px field + fine picture dots), 1 = Halftone (one grid)

entry.name: FinePitch
entry.label: Glyph field look: picture dot pitch in px (3, 4, 6 or 8), 0 = auto from the picture size

entry.name: DotPitch
entry.label: Halftone look: grid pitch in px (3..16)

entry.name: Levels
entry.label: Number of dot sizes (3..6), 0 = continuous

entry.name: MinDotSize
entry.label: Smallest dot, fraction of the pitch

entry.name: Contrast
entry.label: Contrast (1 = neutral)

entry.name: Brightness
entry.label: Brightness / gamma (1 = neutral, higher = more and larger dots)

entry.name: AutoLevels
entry.label: Stretch each picture's tones automatically (helps dark art)

entry.name: BlackPoint
entry.label: Manual black point 0..1 (Auto levels off)

entry.name: WhitePoint
entry.label: Manual white point 0..1 (Auto levels off)

entry.name: ColorMode
entry.label: 0 = monochrome white, 1 = original colour, 2 = mono + Nothing red accent

entry.name: EdgeEmphasis
entry.label: Detail: subtle sharpening and edge boost (line art)

entry.name: BackgroundGrid
entry.label: Faint background dot grid where the picture is dark

entry.name: Animate
entry.label: Animate: Glyph sweep every 8 s (off = static, no timer)

entry.name: Twinkle
entry.label: Gentle twinkle between sweeps
